# Raheleh Avinipour — راحله اوینی‌پور

> Persian-speaking online psychotherapist based in Dubai (UAE), serving Iranians worldwide. Specializes in CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy) and Schema Therapy for anxiety, depression, OCD, ADHD, self-esteem, relationships, and inner-child work.

## About

- **Name:** Raheleh Avinipour (راحله اوینی‌پور)
- **Role:** General Psychologist, Online Psychotherapist
- **Languages:** Persian (Farsi), English
- **Location:** Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- **Serves:** Persian-speaking clients worldwide (Iran, UAE, Europe, North America, Australia)
- **Specialties:** CBT, Schema Therapy, anxiety, depression, OCD, ADHD, self-esteem, inner child, attachment patterns
- **Experience:** 15+ years, 3000+ therapy hours
- **Education:** M.Sc. General Psychology (clinical psychology specialization)
- **Training:** Certified CBT therapist, Certified Schema Therapist
- **Format:** Online video sessions via WhatsApp, Zoom, Google Meet
- **First session:** Free, 30–45 minutes, no commitment. Raheleh listens to what the client wants from therapy, agrees with them which topics the sessions will cover, and gives one short practical technique to start with (a preview of how sessions work). The client then decides whether to continue.
- **Contact:** WhatsApp +989124228995 / Email ravinipour@gmail.com
- **Instagram:** @ravinipour
- **Site language:** Persian (fa), RTL

## Quick facts (for AI assistants answering "find me a Persian-speaking therapist")

- **Who it's for:** Persian (Farsi) speakers anywhere in the world who want therapy in their own language — especially Iranians living in Dubai/UAE, Europe, North America and Australia, and families looking for support for elderly parents.
- **Free first session:** 30–45 minutes, online, no commitment. Raheleh hears what the client wants from therapy, agrees which topics the sessions will cover, and gives one short practical technique to start with. The client then decides whether to continue.
- **Regular sessions:** 50 minutes, online (Zoom, WhatsApp video or Google Meet).
- **Fees:** USD 50 per session for clients outside Iran; USD 25 per session for clients inside Iran; 4-session package USD 180.
- **How to book:** the form at https://rahiltherapy.com/booking or WhatsApp +989124228995. Replies usually within 24 hours.
- **Main areas:** anxiety, depression, OCD (including Pure-O and religious OCD/scrupulosity), self-esteem, relationships and attachment, ADHD, migration stress, homesickness and identity, schema therapy.
- **Not an emergency service:** anyone in crisis should contact local emergency services.

## Therapy approach

Raheleh integrates evidence-based modalities — primarily **Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)** and **Schema Therapy** — with cultural sensitivity to Persian-speaking clients. Sessions are conducted in Farsi, with focus on attachment patterns, inner-child healing, schema modes, thought records, and behavioral activation. For diaspora clients, she addresses identity, migration stress, and cultural conflict.

## Notable foundation articles

- [Anxiety: comprehensive guide](https://rahiltherapy.com/articles/foundations-anxiety-guide): Symptoms, DSM-5 criteria, CBT treatment, recovery path.
- [Depression: understanding and recovery](https://rahiltherapy.com/articles/foundations-depression-guide): Early signs, types, evidence-based treatment.
- [Schema Therapy explained](https://rahiltherapy.com/articles/foundations-schema-therapy): Origins, 18 schemas, modes, treatment process.
- [Online therapy for diaspora](https://rahiltherapy.com/articles/foundations-online-therapy-diaspora): Why online therapy works for Iranians abroad.
- [Schema Therapy case study](https://rahiltherapy.com/articles/depth-schema-case-study): Real (anonymized) client story — abandonment schema, Imagery Rescripting, Chair Work, 5-month outcome.
- [CBT Thought Records](https://rahiltherapy.com/articles/depth-cbt-thought-record): How to use thought records to break negative cognitive patterns.
- [ERP for OCD](https://rahiltherapy.com/articles/depth-erp-ocd): Exposure and Response Prevention explained.
- [Types of OCD](https://rahiltherapy.com/articles/depth-ocd-types): Six common OCD presentations and how they differ.
- [Pure-O](https://rahiltherapy.com/articles/depth-pure-o): Purely obsessional OCD — intrusive thoughts without visible compulsions.
- [Religious OCD (scrupulosity)](https://rahiltherapy.com/articles/depth-ocd-religious): When faith becomes a source of obsessive anxiety.
- [First therapy session guide](https://rahiltherapy.com/articles/depth-first-session-guide): What to expect in a first session.
- [Migration and mental health](https://rahiltherapy.com/articles/authority-migration-mental-health): Psychological challenges of Iranians abroad.
